events.title: Anthropic previews the Model Hardware Standard for agent-controlled devices
events.title_zh: Anthropic 预发布 Model Hardware Standard，让 agent 安全操作物理设备
events.published_at_note: Anthropic newsroom entry dated 2026-08-27 (no timestamp published). Coverage-gap recovery: within the previous run's window but missed; first seen 2026-08-29 run.
events.summary: Anthropic opened a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a shared specification for AI agents to safely operate physical devices. Each device gets a standardized driver exposing read/write primitives, a network discovery format, and natural-language capability tags from which the driver auto-generates a reference file covering what the device can measure, what is adjustable, and its safety limits — with limits enforced at the driver level. Agents connect through MCP, a CLI, or code APIs, and can chain driver commands into deterministic scripts for long or fast operations. Phase 1 opens to a first group of scientific research labs and advanced manufacturers; the spec itself is not public yet, with open-sourcing planned. Vendors building drivers include AWS (Strands Robots), Tecan, QIAGEN, Doosan, Universal Robots, Automata, Danaher, MBF Bioscience, Hugging Face (LeRobot) and Raspberry Pi.
events.why_it_matters: This is the first serious attempt to standardize the agent-to-physical-device interface the way MCP standardized agent-to-tool access — and it is explicitly MCP-compatible and model-agnostic. Lab-automation and industrial teams should consider joining phase 1; for everyone else the signal is that computer use is moving from screen-scraping toward device-level contracts with enforced safety limits.
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 开放了 Model Hardware Standard（MHS）研究预览：一份让 AI agent 安全操作物理设备的共享规范。每台设备配一个标准化 driver，只暴露 read / write 两类原语；配套网络发现格式，以及用自然语言描述设备特性（如机械臂负载）后自动生成的参考文件——说明设备能测什么、能调什么、安全边界在哪，边界由 driver 层强制执行。agent 可通过 MCP、CLI 或代码 API 接入，还能把 driver 命令串成确定性脚本执行长流程。第一阶段面向首批科研实验室与先进制造企业开放申请；规范本身尚未公开，官方称后续会开源。已宣布参与构建 driver 的厂商包括 AWS（Strands Robots）、Tecan、QIAGEN、Doosan、Universal Robots、Automata、Danaher、MBF Bioscience、Hugging Face（LeRobot）与 Raspberry Pi。
events.why_it_matters_zh: 这是第一个认真尝试把 agent 与物理设备的接口标准化的工作——定位类似 MCP 对 agent 与工具接口的标准化，且明确兼容 MCP、不限模型。做实验室自动化或工业自动化的团队值得申请第一阶段；对其他人，信号意义在于 computer use 正从「截屏点按」转向带强制安全边界的设备级契约。

Agents connect through MCP, a CLI, or code APIs, and can chain driver commands into deterministic scripts for long or fast operations. Phase 1 opens to a first group of scientific research labs and advanced manufacturers; the spec itself is not public yet, with open-sourcing planned. Vendors building drivers include AWS (Strands Robots), Tecan, QIAGEN, Doosan, Universal Robots, Automata, Danaher, MBF Bioscience, Hugging Face (LeRobot) and Raspberry Pi.

technical_details.origin: developed with HHMI Janelia Research Campus; grew out of a shared-memory state dictionary by researcher Arco Bast and Anthropic's Alek Kemeny
technical_details.driver: read/write primitives; standardized discovery format; natural-language machine characteristics -> auto-generated reference file (measurable, adjustable, safety limits); safety limits enforced in driver
technical_details.control_planes: MCP, CLI, code files (APIs); state dictionary in shared memory; deterministic command chaining for long/fast operations
technical_details.access: research preview, phase 1 for selected scientific research labs and advanced manufacturers; apply at modelhardwarestandard.com
technical_details.spec_code: not publicly released yet; open-sourcing planned; CMU drivers to be made public later
technical_details.vendors: AWS (Strands Robots), Tecan, QIAGEN, Doosan, Universal Robots, Automata, Danaher, MBF Bioscience, Hugging Face (LeRobot), Raspberry Pi
technical_details.device_examples: microscopes, liquid handlers, robotic arms, plate readers, lasers — any device with a programmable interface

technical_details_zh.设备示例: 显微镜、移液工作站、机械臂、酶标仪、激光器——任何带可编程接口的设备

events.title: Google makes Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generally available at lower cost
events.title_zh: Google 将 Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash 推向 GA 并降价
events.published_at_note: Google blog post dated 2026-08-27. Coverage-gap recovery: within the previous run's window but missed; first seen 2026-08-29 run.
events.summary: Google made Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generally available through the Gemini API and Google Cloud. It generates native 15-second clips, supports multi-turn conversational editing and improves reference consistency. Google says pricing is 30% lower than the prior line; the result remains vendor-reported and the API pricing page is the source of exact rates.
events.why_it_matters: For teams building video workflows, GA support, provisioned throughput and lower unit cost change Omni from a creative preview into a production candidate, but visual quality and effective cost still need workload-specific tests.
events.summary_zh: Google 将 Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash 通过 Gemini API 与 Google Cloud 推向 GA。它可原生生成 15 秒视频，支持多轮对话编辑，并改善参考素材一致性。Google 称价格降低 30%；效果仍是厂商自报，具体费率以 API 定价页为准。
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对视频工作流团队来说，GA、Provisioned Throughput 与更低单价让 Omni 从创意预览变成生产候选；画质和真实成本仍需按自身素材验证。
events.summary_en: Google made Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generally available through the Gemini API and Google Cloud. It generates native 15-second clips, supports multi-turn conversational editing and improves reference consistency. Google says pricing is 30% lower than the prior line; the result remains vendor-reported and the API pricing page is the source of exact rates.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams building video workflows, GA support, provisioned throughput and lower unit cost change Omni from a creative preview into a production candidate, but visual quality and effective cost still need workload-specific tests.

evidence.claim_zh: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash 是 Google 生成式视频产品线的 GA 更新：新增 4K 超分、最长 40 秒的场景延长、首尾帧关键帧控制，以及先用 360p 草稿档低成本试错再出正片的模式。已通过 Gemini API 提供，AI Plus / Pro / Ultra 订阅用户可在 Gemini 应用与 Google Flow 中使用。
evidence.claim_en: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash is a production-ready (GA) update to Google's generative video line: 4K upscaling, scene extension up to 40 seconds, first-and-last-frame keyframe control, and a 360p drafting mode for cheaper iterations before the final render. It is available through the Gemini API and, for AI Plus / Pro / Ultra subscribers, in the Gemini app and Google Flow.

evidence.claim_en: The official announcement confirms Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash is GA in the API and Google Cloud, supports 15-second clips and multi-turn editing, and reports a 30% price reduction.

events.title: Nvidia signs Hugging Face deal as DOJ asks competition questions
events.title_zh: Nvidia 签署 Hugging Face 交易，DOJ 据报询问竞争问题
events.published_at_note: The Information first reported the agreement on 2026-08-27; CNBC ('reportedly agrees') same day; Reuters confirmation 2026-08-28. Earlier signals: Business Insider reported talks above $13B; TechCrunch 'closing in' on 2026-08-26. No official statement from either company as of 2026-08-30. Coverage-gap recovery: inside the previous window [2026-08-24T00:00:29Z, 2026-08-28T00:31:03Z] but not captured then; first seen 2026-08-30 run.
events.summary: Nvidia and Hugging Face signed a definitive transaction. The SEC filing states $11.9 billion in cash plus up to $1 billion in retention consideration, an expected close in the first half of 2027 subject to approvals, and a commitment to keep the platform open. Reuters reports that the U.S. Justice Department has made competition inquiries; no public DOJ document or enforcement action was found.
events.why_it_matters: For teams that rely on the Hub, distribution neutrality is now an explicit regulatory question rather than a hypothetical concern. The deal has not closed, so no operational change is implied; portability and public approval conditions are the decision points.
events.summary_zh: Nvidia 与 Hugging Face 已签署正式交易协议。SEC 文件列明 119 亿美元现金与最高 10 亿美元留任对价，预计在取得批准后于 2027 年上半年完成，并承诺保持平台开放。Reuters 据两名消息人士报道，美国司法部已询问竞争问题；目前没有公开 DOJ 文件或执法行动。
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对依赖 Hub 的团队来说，分发中立性已从假设风险变成明确的监管问题。交易尚未完成，不能据此推断当前运营变化；模型镜像可迁移性与公开审批条件才是决策点。
events.summary_en: Nvidia and Hugging Face signed a definitive transaction. The SEC filing states $11.9 billion in cash plus up to $1 billion in retention consideration, an expected close in the first half of 2027 subject to approvals, and a commitment to keep the platform open. Reuters reports that the U.S. Justice Department has made competition inquiries; no public DOJ document or enforcement action was found.

events.update_2026_09_03: OFFICIAL CONFIRMATION: Jensen Huang's blog 'NVIDIA to Acquire Hugging Face' (2026-09-03) — transaction valued at $12,930,300,000 (press coverage: ~$11.9B to investors plus up to $1B employee-retention equity). Commitments stated: Hugging Face remains an open platform for the entire AI ecosystem, no Nvidia-compute mandate, 🤗 brand retained. Closing terms, regulatory path, and dates not stated. Watch-item status: official confirmation MET; closing terms, Hub-neutrality execution, and regulatory movement remain open. Stays WATCH (deal not closed)

evidence.claim_zh: 多家媒体报道 Nvidia 已同意以 129 亿美元收购 Hugging Face——常被称为「AI 界 GitHub」的模型仓库，价格约为 HF 年收入的 86 倍，是 Nvidia 史上最大规模的交易之一。报道时间线：Business Insider 先披露 130 亿美元以上的谈判，TechCrunch 8/26 称「接近成交」，The Information 8/27 报道已达成协议，Reuters 与 CNBC 随后跟进。截至 8/30 两家公司均无官方声明；监管审查与交割在前，Hub 是否给出中立性承诺也未知。
evidence.claim_en: Multiple outlets report Nvidia has agreed to acquire Hugging Face, the repository commonly called the 'GitHub of AI', for $12.9 billion — roughly 86x Hugging Face's revenue and among Nvidia's largest deals ever. Reporting timeline: Business Insider flagged talks above $13B, TechCrunch wrote 'closing in' on 8/26, and The Information reported the agreement on 8/27 with Reuters and CNBC following. Neither company has issued an official statement as of 2026-08-30; regulatory review and closing remain ahead, and terms of any neutrality commitments for the Hub are unknown.

evidence.claim_zh: SEC 文件确认交易条款与待批准状态；Reuters 报道 DOJ 正询问竞争问题，但没有公开执法文件。

evidence.verification: primary filing plus attributed secondary report
